sections.heading: Tumakuru: Food Park, Helicopter Factory and an 8,484-Acre Industrial Township
paragraphs: Tumakuru, about 70 km north-west of Bengaluru on the Mumbai–Chennai highway, has three industrial anchors. The oldest is the India Food Park, which Wikipedia records as India's first mega food park under the food processing ministry, inaugurated by the Prime Minister in September 2014. The second is Hindustan Aeronautics' greenfield helicopter factory at Gubbi, which the Prime Minister dedicated to the nation on 6 February 2023; PIB describes it as Asia's largest helicopter manufacturing facility, starting with the 3-tonne Light Utility Helicopter and planned to build more than 1,000 helicopters over 20 years with around 6,000 jobs, on a site Shephard puts at 615 acres.

The third is still being built. On the same day in 2023 the Prime Minister laid the foundation stone of the Tumakuru Industrial Township, 8,484 acres in three phases under the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme as part of the Chennai Bengaluru Industrial Corridor, with multimodal links to the highway, Bengaluru airport, Tumakuru railway station and Mangaluru port. He called it, after the Food Park and HAL, the project that would make Tumakuru a major industrial centre.

sections.heading: The Tumkur Milk Union: 7.5 Lakh Litres a Day
paragraphs: For a supplier of hygienic tube, the most important plant in Tumakuru today is the dairy. The Tumkur Co-operative Milk Producers' Societies Union was set up under a World Bank project in 1975 and registered on 30 March 1977 with the whole district as its area. It started as a 30,000-litre farm cooler feeding the Bangalore market, became a 60,000-litre feeder plant in 1981, grew to 1 lakh litres a day in 2005 and 3.25 lakh litres with a new packing block in 2013, added a flexi-pack block in 2016, and now processes 7.5 lakh litres a day. The union is certified to ISO 22000:2018.

A dairy that has expanded this many times is a dairy with pipework of many ages, and each expansion is a chance to specify properly. Raw milk reception, chilled storage and plain pasteurised milk lines run well on SF1 mechanically polished 304L, cleaned daily by CIP. The electropolished finish pays on cultured products such as curd and buttermilk, on flavoured milk and ice-cream mix where sugar and stabilisers cling, on any evaporator or powder-feed line where protein bakes on, and on the CIP return leg that is sampled to prove a circuit clean. Those lines are specified SF4 316L to ASME BPE surface designations.

sections.heading: Food Park Units and the Township: Grade and Finish
paragraphs: The India Food Park and the food and agro-processing plots planned in the township bring the standard food-plant split. SF4 electropolished 316L belongs on product-contact lines that carry acidic, hot, viscous or allergen-bearing products, on fruit pulp and concentrate, sauces and ready-to-eat lines, and on CIP return. SF1 304L or 316L is adequate for treated process water, chilled water and utilities. Edible oil and dry-ingredient handling, which Tumakuru's coconut economy favours, needs little electropolished tube at all.

Chlorides decide the grade. Brine, pickles, salted products and chlorinated sanitiser standing in a warm line pit 304L, so 316L is the choice for those lines and for hot CIP supply. Where a food or chemical process uses acid or chloride-bearing streams at temperature, we quote 904L, which we supply electropolished. The aerospace plant is a different customer: its demand is for clean compressed air and gas lines, test-rig instrument tube and surface-treatment chemical lines, where 316L and 904L electropolished instrument tube to ASTM A269 is the usual specification.

sections.heading: Documents for a Tumakuru Dairy, Food Park or Township Project
paragraphs: Each heat we supply carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number, with chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory, so an ISO 22000 dairy or an FSSAI-licensed food unit can file the material record against the line list. Every length is PMI tested before dispatch, and each electropolished lot comes with our internal Ra report. Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

We supply ASTM A270 sanitary tube, ASTM A269 seamless and A249 welded tube and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L. If a turnkey dairy contractor, a food auditor or a defence-plant vendor file calls for witness points, extra tests or a particular marking format, include it with the enquiry so the quotation covers it.

sections.heading: Sending a Tumakuru RFQ
paragraphs: We return a quotation within 24 hours of a complete enquiry. For the dairy, the Food Park, the new township or the HAL complex at Gubbi, please tell us:
bullets: The plant and line: raw or pasteurised milk, cultured product, ice-cream mix, concentrate, CIP, a food product line, clean gas or instrument tube, and whether you are the owner, a turnkey contractor or an equipment builder.
Grade and finish per line: SF4 316L for cultured product, concentrate and CIP return; SF1 304L or 316L for plain milk, water and utilities; 904L electropolished for acid or chloride service.
Tube OD, wall, length and quantity, with the dimension series and standard (ASTM A270, A269, A249 or A312) and the fittings they join to.
Inspection or audit documentation needed, and the delivery address in Tumakuru district.
